caramel and cheese together, the city's own

Fresh popcorn split in two: half tossed in bubbling caramel and baked crisp, half tossed in butter and cheddar powder, then mixed together in one big bowl. Pop 120g popcorn kernels in oil and split between 2 bowls. For the caramel half, boil 60g butter, 120g brown sugar and 2 tbsp golden syrup for 3 minutes, stir in a pinch of bicarb, toss through one bowl and bake on a tray at 120C for 30 minutes, stirring twice, then cool. For the cheese half, toss the other bowl with 40g melted butter and 3 tbsp cheddar cheese powder and a pinch of salt. Mix both together in one big bowl.

Deep pan pizza dough pressed into a tin, layered with mozzarella, Italian sausage and chunky tomato sauce, baked at 220C for 30 minutes. Mix 400g plain flour, 50g fine semolina, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp salt, 60ml olive oil and 250ml warm water, knead 5 minutes and rise 1 hour. Press into an oiled 25cm cake tin and up the sides. Layer 300g sliced mozzarella on the base, then 400g Italian sausage meat pressed flat and browned. Top with a 400g tin crushed tomatoes simmered 10 minutes with garlic and oregano. Sprinkle with parmesan and bake at 220C for 30 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before cutting.

Fresh raspberries crushed with lemon and a touch of sugar, topped with cold sparkling wine in flutes. Sparkling grape juice for non-drinkers. Crush 125g raspberries with 1 tbsp caster sugar and the juice of half a lemon and push through a sieve. Spoon 1 tbsp of purée into each of 4 flutes. Slowly top with cold sparkling wine from a 750ml bottle and drop a whole raspberry in each. For non-drinkers, use sparkling grape juice.

s.note: the seafood restaurant where everyone sings
s.how: Finely dice 2 eschalots and stir into 100ml red wine vinegar with cracked black pepper. Lay a dozen freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice. Spoon a little dressing over each and serve with lemon wedges, like a fancy Chicago lunch.

s.note: Kimmy singing badly at the karaoke bar
s.how: Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Warm 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy sauce and crushed garlic until sticky. Toss the wings through and scatter with sesame seeds. Sing badly between bites.

m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thin fries and fry twice until crisp. Sear 4 sirloin steaks and rest. Toast cracked peppercorns in the pan, add 200ml cream and simmer until thick. Serve with the fries and a green salad, reviewed harshly.

w.note: Jules saying Kimmy is crème brûlée and she's jelly
w.how: Make up a packet of raspberry jelly and set in small cups. Heat 600ml cream with a split vanilla bean, whisk into 6 yolks and 80g sugar, strain into ramekins and bake in a water bath at 150C for 35 minutes. Chill, torch the sugar and serve with the jelly.
